fields.label: Merchant ID (MID)
fields.description: Paytm Merchant ID from your Paytm Business Dashboard. Identifies your merchant account.

fields.label: Merchant Key (Secret)
fields.description: Paytm Merchant Key from the Business Dashboard. Used to sign API requests — keep this confidential.

fields.label: Payment Account
fields.description: ERPNext bank/cash account to which Paytm settlements will be credited.

fields.label: Mode of Payment
fields.description: ERPNext Mode of Payment used when creating Payment Entries (default: Paytm).

fields.label: Staging / Test Mode
fields.description: Enable to route all API calls to Paytm's staging environment. Disable in production.

fields.label: System User
fields.description: ERPNext user under whose name Sales Invoices and Payment Entries will be created. Must have create permission on both doctypes.
